newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NatSteel, Brazil Acominas talks continue.
newsitem.headline: NatSteel, Brazil Acominas talks continue.

text.p: Diversified Singapore steel group NatSteel Ltd said on Wednesday a consortium's talks on acquiring a stake in Brazil's integrated steel producer Aco Minas Gerais S.A. (Acominas) were still going on.
"We are still carrying on talks with the company," NatSteel president Ang Kong Hua told a news conference following the announcement of NatSteel's 1996 results.
"But discussions have not resulted in any binding investment or participation," he said.
Ang said NatSteel, which is seeking a stake with partners he would not identify, was interested in Acominas as a major supplier of steel feedstock in Asia.
"Having a good presence in Asia, we need to strengthen our vertical presence. If we find a low-cost producer, we would like to anchor ourselves," Ang said.
Ang said Acominas was also talking to other investors on bringing in new investments.
He declined to give an estimate of the investment amount needed.
